domain_guidance.summary: This domain comprehensively covers the fundamental principles and concepts of an information security management system, accounting for 18.75% of the evaluation to test your core theoretical understanding.

This specific domain focuses heavily on information security management system requirements, which make up exactly 15.0% of the evaluation and outline the mandatory criteria needed for successful compliance.
This specific domain comprehensively addresses the planning phase of an ISMS implementation based on ISO/IEC 27001, carrying the highest weight at 22.5% within the entire evaluation structure.
This section pertains to the execution and implementation of an ISMS based on ISO/IEC 27001, weighted at 17.5% to emphasize practical deployment skills and security controls.
This domain centers on the monitoring and measurement of an ISMS based on ISO/IEC 27001, representing 12.5% of the content focused on evaluating performance and metrics.
This domain examines the continual improvement of an ISMS based on ISO/IEC 27001, covering 7.5% of the evaluation to ensure long-term adaptability and corrective action execution.

This final evaluation domain involves preparation for an ISMS certification audit, accounting for precisely 6.25% of the total content to ensure complete audit readiness and organizational compliance.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time across the 80 questions to ensure you can address each domain effectively. Keep the 70% passing requirement in mind and check with PECB for the current certification path.

faq.answer_text: The certification exam consists of a total of 80 questions covering all seven domains of information security management systems according to ISO/IEC 27001 standards.

faq.answer_text: The passing score required for the PECB ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer Certification is set at 70%. Be sure to check with PECB for the current certification path.
The certification is administered by PECB. It covers topics ranging from fundamental principles to audit preparation across all 7 distinct domains of the evaluation framework.

methodology.summary: This page was built using official PECB and ISO source documentation, detailing the domains, weights, and rules for the ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer Certification.

editorial.overview: The ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer Certification, administered by PECB, comprehensively evaluates your capability to plan, implement, manage, and continuously improve an information security management system. The rigorous evaluation consists of exactly 80 questions and requires achieving a passing score of 70% to successfully certify under standard professional guidelines.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review each domain very carefully according to its specified weight, focusing heavily on implementation planning at 22.5% and fundamental principles at 18.75%. Practice applying the management system requirements and study measurement techniques carefully. Always check with PECB for the current certification path.
editorial.who_should_take: Professionals responsible for information security management, risk management, or regulatory compliance within their organizations who need to establish and maintain an information security management system.
